links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of LLM-generated button battery recommendations
links.effect: Both models showed similar readability with high FKGL and FRE scores indicating college-level comprehension, above typical public/patient reading levels.
links.quote: Both models showed similar readability levels, with high FKGL and FRE scores indicating college-level comprehension.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and readability of LLM (ChatGPT-4o and o1-preview) responses to public health questions regarding button battery ingestion, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
